Name: Event Service Message Registry
Description: This registry defines messages for the lifecycle of Redfish event subscriptions and the health of event delivery.

EventSubscriptionCreated.Description: Indicates that an event subscription was created and is now active.
EventSubscriptionCreated.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that an event subscription was created and is now active.
EventSubscriptionCreated.Message: Event subscription '%1' was created successfully with protocol '%2' and destination '%3'.
EventSubscriptionCreated.Example: Event subscription 'contoso-listener' was created successfully with protocol 'Redfish' and destination 'https://contoso.com/events'.
ArgDescriptions: The identifier of the event subscription.
The protocol of the event subscription.
The destination URI of the event subscription.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain a string that identifies the event subscription that was removed successfully.
This argument shall contain the protocol from the `Protocol` property of the event subscription.
This argument shall contain the destination URI from the `Destination` property of the event subscription.

EventSubscriptionRemoved.Description: Indicates that an event subscription was removed and is no longer active.
EventSubscriptionRemoved.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that an event subscription was removed and is no longer active.
EventSubscriptionRemoved.Message: Event subscription '%1' was removed successfully with protocol '%2' and destination '%3'.
EventSubscriptionRemoved.Example: Event subscription 'contoso-listener' was removed successfully with protocol 'Redfish' and destination 'https://contoso.com/events'.
ArgDescriptions: The identifier of the event subscription.
The protocol of the event subscription.
The destination URI of the event subscription.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain a string that identifies the event subscription that was removed successfully.
This argument shall contain the protocol from the `Protocol` property of the event subscription.
This argument shall contain the destination URI from the `Destination` property of the event subscription.
EventSubscriptionRemoved.Resolution: Crated a new event subscription if continued event delivery is required.

EventDeliveryFailed.Description: Indicates that an attempt to deliver an event to a subscriber failed.
EventDeliveryFailed.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that an attempt to deliver an event to a subscriber failed.  This message shall only be used after all retries are performed.  This message shall not be used for subscriptions configured to retry forever.
EventDeliveryFailed.Message: Event delivery to subscriber '%1' failed with protocol '%2' and destination '%3'.
EventDeliveryFailed.Example: Event delivery to subscriber 'contoso-listener' failed with protocol 'Redfish' and destination 'https://contoso.com/events'.
ArgDescriptions: The identifier of the event subscription.
The protocol of the event subscription.
The destination URI of the event subscription.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain a string that identifies the event subscription for which the event delivery failed.
This argument shall contain the protocol from the `Protocol` property of the event subscription.
This argument shall contain the destination URI from the `Destination` property of the event subscription.
EventDeliveryFailed.Resolution: Check the subscriber endpoint availability and network connectivity.  Check the configuration of the event subscription.

EventDeliverySucceededWithRetries.Description: Indicates that an attempt to deliver an event to a subscriber succeeded, but required retries.
EventDeliverySucceededWithRetries.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that an attempt to deliver an event to a subscriber succeeded, but required retries.  This message shall only be used when retries were performed.
EventDeliverySucceededWithRetries.Message: Event delivery to subscriber '%1' succeeded with protocol '%2' and destination '%3' after %4 retries.
EventDeliverySucceededWithRetries.Example: Event delivery to subscriber 'contoso-listener' succeeded with protocol 'Redfish' and destination 'https://contoso.com/events' after 3 retries.
ArgDescriptions: The identifier of the event subscription.
The protocol of the event subscription.
The destination URI of the event subscription.
The number of retries that were performed.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain a string that identifies the event subscription for which the event delivery failed.
This argument shall contain the protocol from the `Protocol` property of the event subscription.
This argument shall contain the destination URI from the `Destination` property of the event subscription.
This argument shall contain the number of retries that were performed.
EventDeliverySucceededWithRetries.Resolution: Check the subscriber endpoint availability and network connectivity.  Check the configuration of the event subscription.

EventSubscriptionSuspended.Description: Indicates that an event subscription was suspended.
EventSubscriptionSuspended.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that an event subscription was suspended.  Services may suspend an event subscription due to repeated delivery failures or an administrator performing the `EventDestnation.SuspendSubscription` action.
EventSubscriptionSuspended.Message: Event subscription '%1' was suspended with protocol '%2' and destination '%3'.
EventSubscriptionSuspended.Example: Event subscription 'contoso-listener' was suspended with protocol 'Redfish' and destination 'https://contoso.com/events'.
ArgDescriptions: The identifier of the event subscription.
The protocol of the event subscription.
The destination URI of the event subscription.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain a string that identifies the event subscription that was suspended.
This argument shall contain the protocol from the `Protocol` property of the event subscription.
This argument shall contain the destination URI from the `Destination` property of the event subscription.
EventSubscriptionSuspended.Resolution: Determine the reason for suspension.  If due to delivery failures, check subscriber endpoint availability and check the subscription configuration.  If due to an administrative action, resume the subscription when necessary.

EventSubscriptionResumed.Description: Indicates that an event subscription was resumed.
EventSubscriptionResumed.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that an event subscription was resumed.  Services may resume an event subscription due an administrator performing the `EventDestnation.ResumeSubscription` action.
EventSubscriptionResumed.Message: Event subscription '%1' was resumed with protocol '%2' and destination '%3'.
EventSubscriptionResumed.Example: Event subscription 'contoso-listener' was resumed with protocol 'Redfish' and destination 'https://contoso.com/events'.
ArgDescriptions: The identifier of the event subscription.
The protocol of the event subscription.
The destination URI of the event subscription.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain a string that identifies the event subscription that was resumed.
This argument shall contain the protocol from the `Protocol` property of the event subscription.
This argument shall contain the destination URI from the `Destination` property of the event subscription.
